scientific_integrity: All-parameter analytic proof paired with 368 exact-rational supplementary checks. General budgeted spectral optimization and equal-price double-broom results are credited as prior art; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applicable to proper double stars with at least two leaves at each hub, positive prices uniform within each spoke class, arbitrary positive bridge price, and continuous-time symmetric diffusion. Not a classification of individual heterogeneous spoke prices, longer trees, directed or discrete-time dynamics. Publication priority beyond inspected references requires expert review.
title: Three-phase optimal edge budgets on heterogeneous-cost double-star networks
